prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: one standalone raster game UI component for 茶园物语, saved separately for Godot. Input Image1 is approved existing popup reference: match its ivory paper, muted bamboo brown thin double outline, softly scalloped traditional corners, sparse Chinese ink/light-watercolor painting. Image2 is Figma layout reference, use only its visual language, not whole interface. Face-on flat 2D UI, all horizontal/vertical edges parallel to canvas, NO scene isometric perspective. Clean flat color fields, subtle broad washes only, smooth sparse brushwork, clean edges; NO grain, mottled noise, distress, muddy haze, glossy 3D, neon or oversaturation.
Palette ivory #f5efdf, muted bamboo brown #9c8058, sage #829276, charcoal #5c6559. All central writing areas should remain blank and quiet. One component only, complete and centered with safe transparent margin. True alpha PNG outside the component, no white backdrop, baked checkerboard, shadow or glow. No words, numbers, Chinese characters, UI labels, watermarks, mockup screen, attached buttons, extra items, people or scenery. Generate the NORMAL state of one empty action button. Broad horizontal cartouche, muted medium bamboo-brown fill, thin pale ivory inner keyline and warm-brown outer stroke, subtly lobed symmetrical short ends. Simple elegant flat UI, no leaves, stamps or internal patterns. Blank central label area. Centered on landscape1536x1024 canvas; button roughly x170..1366 and y330..694, symmetrical around(768,512). Keep geometry simple so further hover/pressed/disabled variants can share shape and canvas.
